req.title: Retrieve player by ID
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/{playerId} with the corresponding player object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /players/{playerId} returning HTTP 200 with a matching Player object. Tests must cover: (1) EP positive — known UUID returns 200 + exact player fields; (2) NEG negative — non-existent UUID returns 404; (3) BVA boundary — malformed/non-UUID path segment returns 422 (FastAPI path validation); (4) DT — all optional fields present vs absent; (5) STC — UUID from first and last seeded rows to catch off-by-one in routing. Assertions use exact values to kill constant, comparison, and boolean-negation mutations. All UUIDs and field values are taken verbatim from the pre-loaded fixture.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_known_uuid_returns_200_and_exact_fields
expected: Response body matches all fields of the Messi fixture row exactly
trace: R-PLAYER-002: system shall respond with HTTP 200 and matching Player object
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_known_uuid_returns_200_and_exact_fields():
    player_id = 'acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == player_id
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Lionel'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Andrés'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'RW'
    assert body['team'] == 'Paris Saint-Germain'
    assert body['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert body['starting11'] == True

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_empty_string_path_returns_405_or_404
actions: Send GET /players/ (trailing slash, no id segment — hits the list endpoint)
expected: HTTP 200 from the list endpoint (not the by-id endpoint) — confirms routing is distinct
trace: R-PLAYER-002: negative path — confirms /players/ and /players/{id} are distinct routes; catches routing mutations
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_empty_string_path_returns_list_not_single():
    r_list = client.get('/players/')
    assert r_list.status_code == 200
    body = r_list.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26
    r_single = client.get('/players/acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c')
    assert r_single.status_code == 200
    single_body = r_single.json()
    assert isinstance(single_body, dict)
    assert 'id' in single_body
    assert single_body['id'] == 'acc433bf-d505-51fe-831e-45eb44c4d43c'
